notes.title: Character Model Update -
notes.content:
This build is not complete.
Just testing high poly mesh character - Human Male.

The default - low poly mesh has been updated to a higher poly mesh.
-------Alert!!
The abilities - I did not include a way to stop players from using abilities.
Since the mesh type is different - and I've only set up Swing ability- ability 1.

The rest of the ability - if clicked will freeze the game.
The game is frame critical - since it is like a fighting game with a Rollback net-code
So on the frame where it identify the action step through - there will be no respond.
[ONLY CLICK SWING ABILITY PLEASE - IF YOU WANT TO TEST ABILITY CAST]

-YOU CAN RESTART TO RESET THE MODEL state

notes.title: Update 2.1.6 (Animation Sync)
notes.content:
Important Note: 
 
Before loading NeverRage please be informed 
that 
0 -Your character must be level 10.
1 -The Barbarian - Human-Male customization are the only 
character customization option that is meant
for the current state of the Game.

-Loading Patch Note:
There were two tasks handling the loading process.
This seems to be an overly-fast way to load the world space.
So, only 1 controller component is handling this job.
The result -is an average loading speed - and a gentle option for such a 
cpu & gpu intensive task.


-Animation
To continue the integration process I have decided to start adding the basic 
Animation sync previews.
 
Only 1 ability has been setup for preview
-Swing
There are 5s (Five Combat Styles) - Swing, Slash, Stab ... etc
When you open the ability panel - the 1st is the Swing ability...read the tool tip if needed.

Sync: 
This ability can now be casted as a visual effect in a multiplayer instance.
This means the local play (you) and the multi-player co-op target (others who are connected)
can see this ability being casted.

-----Note:
Particle effect etc are not part of this preview
Damage has been remove from this ability to allow multiple recast without 
fear of slaying a coop buddy.

notes.title: Update NeverRageClient 2.1.2
notes.content:
-Loading In The Game 

The builds loading script has been move to a slightly faster threading process.
This means, running other high processing tasks while booting the game will cause the game
to crash.
This also mean the game will load a bit quicker.
-There will be a setting-option for this in the future 
(To set how fast you want to loading into the game world)

-Game Play -Multiplayer alignment with the new framework

The game play is currently being patched to run within the scripting framework that was introduced.
Right now - players should be able to load each other (multiplayer mode is enabled)
However, animations are not available for external users.
Device Users can still cast and play animations.

-
We will slowly introduce everything back into the game - 
So stay in touch for more updates!!!

notes.title: Patch 1-3-25 : Camera, Quick Tutorial and Level 10 Booster
notes.content:
Dev Note: 

I've read the review of a .⁧⁧Zinxfinity 
and I've seen your feedback on our channel, @solvated_photon.

Words aren't enough,
This patch is possible because of your help.

Updates
1: Questing - The demo project is no longer synchronized with the matrix. The main build has been updated with a speed-run system which will boost players to level 10, and allow them to explore Dimension 1 out of the remaining 16 possible Dimensions.
2: FreeLocomotion Camera - A 200ms sleep timer was added to the camera due to how fast it was as a multithreaded task. This update was thought of as a universal preference. Sadly, not all devices process the script alike. Thus, it was altered for everyone to experience smooth rendering and locomotion.


We, Kwaza Games,
Hope everyone can accept and play in the confines of these two updates.
